lines.text: Click! The bedroom lamp went out, and thick black shadows filled Whiskers' bedroom!
In the corner stood a tall, spooky shape with giant waving tentacles!
Whiskers pulled his fluffy blanket over his whiskers, shivering with fear!
Then his big brother whispered, Shadows can only copy what is already here!
Whiskers clicked his tiny yellow flashlight and beamed it straight at the monster!
Giggle! It wasn't a monster at all—just his yellow winter jacket and floppy hat!
The dark doesn't create monsters; it just plays funny tricks with sleepy eyes!
Bravery is turning on your little light and seeing the truth for yourself!
Sleep peaceful and brave—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
